The prior source review and its source/build bindings remain applicable because the implementation and reviewed artifacts are unchanged.

This accepts only the approved **provisional TEST_ONLY wire111/base90 slice**. Unsupported capabilities, production authority, broader EXP-07 and whole-engine completion remain unchanged.

**After Codex records its agreement and acceptance, stop for owner review.** No storage inventory, cleanup proposal, removal, Bishop work or successor development is authorized by this acceptance.
